t: Akbar shenniknas lemaqom baduq vekikkar bepiv
s: Akbar shenniknas lemaqom baduq vekikkar bepiv ubo y"b seipim: akbar shenniknas lebayit baduq vekikkar bepiv veniknas acharayv umatza perurin (veim matza kikkar shalem yitbaer besiman tl"t), apillu matza kede kol hakkikkar — tzarik lachazor velibdoq kol habbayit, o ad sheyyimtza oto hakkikkar shehiknis haakbar (perush shemmakkir bitbiut ayin shezzehu hakkikkar shehiknis), lepi sheen darko shel akbar leparer, veellu perurin bevadday hayu sham mittechilla velo meoto kikkar hen. Vaapillu im hakkikkar shehiknis haya qatan meod, sheyyesh litlot velomar shehaakbar akalo, vaapillu im kebar bittel chametzo sheen kan ella sepeq dibre soperim, ap al pi ken en sepeq akilat haakbar motzi mide vadday chametz sherainu shehiknis lesham:

Umikkol maqom en tzarik libdoq ella oto cheder sherainu shenniknas lesham, abal shear hachadarim ap al pi sheppetuchim leoto cheder enam tzerikim bediqa im kebar bittel kol chametzo o sheadayin lo higgia shaa shishshit verotzeh adayin lebattel, sheaz habbediqa enah ella middibre soperim usepeq dibre soperim lehaqel, vetolin lomar shello niknas haakbar im hakkikkar ella leoto cheder sherainu shenniknas lesham. Veim badaq kol oto hacheder velo matza hakkikkar — en chosheshin shemma geraro lishar chadarim habbeduqim, ella tolin lomar sheggeraro mishsham lirshut harabbim, o lechatzer, o lishar meqomot sheenan beduqin kelal hassemukim leoto cheder, o sheggeraro beoto cheder atzmo lechor amoq sheeno yakol lehitgallot mishsham velo yabo leoklo bepesach:

Veim hakkikkar haya qatan beinyan sheyyesh litlot shemma akalo haakbar kullo, apillu im lo bittelo ukebar higgia shaa shishshit sheeno yakol od lebattelo, ap al pi ken en tzarik libdoq shear hachadarim, mippene sheyyesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel, shemma lo hiknis haakbar meolam et hakkikkar lishar hachadarim, veim timtza lomar hiknis shemma akalo kullo velo nishtayyer mimmennu kelum, vekol b' sepeqot holekin bahem lehaqel ap beshel tora:

Veim niknas acharayv (leoto cheder) umatza kikkar umakkir bitbiat ayin shezzehu hakkikkar shennatal, ap al pi shennechesar mimmennu qetzat anu tolin shehaakbar akal qetzato, veen tzarik lachazor velibdoq apillu im lo bittel:

Keleb vetarnegol dinam shaveh leakbar, sheen darkam leparer. Abal im tinoq niknas lebayit baduq vekikkar beyado veniknas acharayv umatza perurin — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq apillu im lo bittel, dekevan shemmiyyad niknas acharayv umatza perurin, hare raglayim laddabar sheakalo hattinoq veellu happerurin hen shennapelu mimmennu bishat akila, shedderek hattinoq leparer. Veyesh omerim sheim en bapperurin kede kol hakkikkar tzarik lachazor velibdoq im hu tinoq sheen bo daat, mippene sheen derek hattinoq leekol ella leparer (abal im hu tinoq sheyyesh bo daat yishalennu, veim omer sheakal — neeman, veal derek shennitbaer besiman tl"z). Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem im lo bittel, sheyyesh kan sepeq issur shel tora. Abal im kebar bittel, o sheadayin yakol lebattel — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, shehi iqqar:

Im niknas akbar lebayit baduq vekikkar bepiv veyatza akbar mishsham vekikkar bepiv — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq apillu im lo bittel veeno yakol od lebattel, dekevan sherainu akbar niknas im kikkar veakbar yatza im kikkar — hare raglayim laddabar sheharishon shenniknas hu haacharon sheyyatza:

Abal im haya harishon shachor vehaacharon laban — tzarik lachazor velibdoq apillu kebar bittelo, veen tolin lomar shehaacharon chatap hakkikkar mippi harishon veyatza, sheen derek haakbarim littol zeh mizzeh kelum:

Veken im akbar niknas lebayit baduq vekikkar bepiv veyatzat mishsham chulda vekikkar bepiha — tzarik lachazor velibdoq apillu im kebar bittelo veen tolin lomar shehachulda chotpa hakkikkar mippi haakbar, sheim haya haddabar ken gam haakbar atzmo haya nimtza bepi hachulda:

Veim yatzat mishsham chulda ubepiha kikkar mikkan veakbar mikkan — hare haddabar sapeq, sheyyesh sebara lomar shezzehu kikkar acher, sheim haya harishon shehaya bepi haakbar shennetalattu chulda im hakkikkar shebbepiha — haya lo lehakkikkar lehimmatze bepi haakbar vehaakbar bepi hachulda. O epshar shezzehu kikkar harishon shehaya bepi haakbar, umah shello nimtza akshav bepi haakbar hu mechamat emat hachulda al haakbar napal hakkikkar mippiv unetalattu hachulda im gup haakbar. Lepikak, im kebar bittelo o sheyyakol adayin lebattelo — en tzarik lachazor velibdoq, shekkol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Abal im lo bittelo veeno yakol od lebattelo — tzarik lachazor velibdoq. Apillu im haya kikkar qatan meod — en tolin lomar sheakalo akbar, lepi shekkol sapeq shel tora holekin bo lehachamir. Veen kan b' sepeqot lehaqel, shessapeq harishon hu shemma zeh hakkikkar shehotzia hachulda hu kikkar harishon shehiknis haakbar venimtza sheen kan od chametz bebayit zeh, vesapeq hashsheni hu shemma akal haakbar et kikkar harishon velo nishtayyer mimmennu kelum venimtzet sheen kan od chametz bebayit zeh, vahare b' hassepeqot hen shem echad, shemma en kan od chametz bebayit zeh, veen sapeq echad mosip al chabero kelum, ulekak enam niddonim kispeq sepeqa. Velo ameru shessepeq akilat haakbar nechshab lesapeq sheni lihyot niddon kispeq sepeqa, ella keshessapeq harishon hu shemma lo niknas meolam chametz lecheder zeh achar shennibdaq, veim timtza lomar niknas shemma neekal kullo velo nishtayyer mimmennu kelum, sheb' sepeqot hallalu hen shemot mechullaqim, sapeq echad shemma lo niknas chametz lekan, vesapeq sheni shemma lo nishar kan chametz. Mah sheen ken keshebbevadday niknas lekan chametz achar habbediqa, ella sheyyesh b' sepeqot behotzaat hechametz mikkan — enan nechshabim ella lesapeq echad, demah li shenneekal hechametz velo nishar mimmennu kelum bebayit zeh, o shehotziattu hachulda velo nishar mimmennu kelum bebayit zeh, hare hakkol sapeq echad, veken kol kayyotze bazeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tl"t:

Nachash shenniknas lebayit baduq vekikkar bepiv — en tzarik liskor chaber lehotzi hakkikkar mippiv im kebar bittelo o sheyyakol adayin lebattelo, sheaz en tzarik lebaaro ella middibre soperim, velo hitrichuhu chakamim lehotzi mamon al kak, kevan sheepshar sheyyokal hannachash et kol hakkikkar o sheyyotziennu mibbayit zeh:

Kezayit chametz shehu munnach betok habbayit lemala al haqqora, ap al pi shekkebar bittelo — mechayyebin oto lehabi sullam lehorido belel y"d, mippene shellipamim yippol mehaqqora veshemma yishkach veyoklennu. Abal im haya chametz babbor, ben sheyyesh bo mayim uben sheen bo, im en derek lered betoko lehishtammesh bo kol hashshana — en chosheshin shemma yered letoko bepesach veyokal mehechametz, lepikak en matrichin oto lehabi sullam lehaalot hechametz mishsham, ella mebattelo vedayyo:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehinniach chametz babbor al daat lepannoto mishsham qodem happesach, o shennapal meelayv, abal asur lehatmin sham chametz al daat sheyyishshaer sham ad achar happesach apillu bittelo. Veim hitmino sham — en moil lo kelum, vetzarik lehotzio ulebaaro bey"d apillu im hitmino sham (g) qodem l' yom lipne happesach, ayyen siman tl"v:
